stem_book: Calculate the magnitude of the work done when a gas expands from 1 m³ to 2 m³ under a constant pressure of 100 kPa. (a) 100 kJ (b) 200 kJ (c) 150 kJ (d) 250 kJ
reason: printed key b (200 kJ) is wrong: |w| = 100 kPa × 1 m³ = 100 kJ; manifest key a already correct. 'magnitude' added since all options are positive (w = −100 kJ by IUPAC sign)
